motion_system: Small marks breathe like chalk dust under night light: pane apertures dim and brighten, lace scallops pulse softly, chair dimples catch brief coral glints.
color_drift: Dusty blue-gray and gray-green remain dominant while acid yellow-green and coral-pink drift along seams, mullions, and exposed cuts.
glow_behavior: Uneven hand-smudged glow pools on carpet, upholstery, glass edges, and wall wounds rather than clean neon bloom.
